Read /home/yangfp/QCIP/reports/xizi_circular_area_release-20260820231001/rounds/xizi_circular_area_release-annotation-r1/agent_input.json.
The goal is to complete the workflow task assigned by the input JSON; /home/yangfp/QCIP/reports/xizi_circular_area_release-20260820231001/rounds/xizi_circular_area_release-annotation-r1/agent_report.json is only the final report file recording the result.

problem_context.problem_statement: 为 CRTOS 原函数 CircularAreaRelease 补充完整 separation-logic annotation 并证明全部 VC。保持函数名、签名、函数体、字段清零和两次 x_free 调用顺序与 Ubiquitous kernel/thread/circular_area.c 一致；函数 spec 不使用参数 @pre，直接使用参数名；仅允许 parser-compatible typedef/include 调整与 annotation/case_lib 修改。
problem_context.expected_behavior: 要求有效 CircularArea 描述符及其已分配 data_buffer；依次清零 readidx/writeidx/p_head/p_tail/b_status/area_length，释放 data_buffer，再释放描述符；返回时不再拥有两块已释放内存。
problem_context.input_output_contract: 前置拥有完整 descriptor allocation 与 data buffer allocation；后置精确释放二者且不泄漏/不保留悬空所有权；不得弱化成 emp/emp 跳过 free 语义。
spec_hint: 使用 QCP malloc/free 可调用规约；保持 operations 字段所有权直到 descriptor free。
forbidden_patterns: 不得修改函数体或 API；不得读取 QCP_demos_human；不得使用 forbidden_lemma.md 中任何 lemma；不得把 free 声明成无效果。

annotation_contract.ready_condition: agent_result.annotation.status == completed and ready_for_annotation_check_round == true only after canonical QCP, case_lib coqc, and annotation-checking pass; self_reworkable_failures must be empty
annotation_contract.blocked_condition: only phase skill hard blockers should use status == blocked; self_repair_budget_exhausted is work evidence, not an automatic blocked condition

mathematical_postconditions_required: Function specs must state what result the function computes, not only bounds or shape facts.
Loop invariants must connect processed state to the final mathematical postcondition.
avoid_spec_antipatterns: Do not weaken the spec to shape-only or bounds-only conditions.
Do not restate the C loops as the mathematical definition.
